criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Inquiries related to account creation, closure, and personal information updates.

categories.name: Card Issues
categories.definition: Questions regarding card functionality, loss, theft, and replacement.

categories.name: Transaction Inquiries
categories.definition: Queries about specific transactions, including charges, fees, and discrepancies.

categories.name: Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Concerns related to sending or receiving money transfers, including failures and delays.

categories.name: Top-Up Problems
categories.definition: Issues regarding adding funds to accounts or cards, including failed or pending top-ups.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions about the process and requirements for verifying identity.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Inquiries about currency conversion rates, fees, and processes.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Questions regarding various fees associated with transactions, cards, and services.

categories.name: Security Concerns
categories.definition: Reports of suspicious activity, unauthorized transactions, and account security.

categories.name: Technical Support
categories.definition: Requests for assistance with app functionality, payment methods, and technical issues.

categories.name: Virtual Cards
categories.definition: Inquiries specifically about virtual cards, including their use and limitations.

categories.name: Payment Methods
categories.definition: Questions about accepted payment methods for transactions and top-ups.

categories.name: Direct Debits
categories.definition: Concerns regarding unauthorized direct debits and their management.

categories.name: ATM Issues
categories.definition: Problems encountered while using ATMs, including withdrawals and card retrieval.

categories.name: Refund Requests
categories.definition: Inquiries about obtaining refunds for transactions or services.
